name: Oku Yutaka
description: 'Late Abundant'. A late-budding hybrid of Yabukita and Yutakamidori, Oku Yutaka combines the robust body of its parents with a refined, less astringent flavor. It is a high-yielding and disease-resistant cultivar, valued for producing a full-bodied Sencha with a rich flavor and a bright green color.
